posts.cooked:
Respected Sir, @sayan

I am appearing for the re-Oppe exam and I am using my VM from last term. However, I am not able to see the se2001 directory that I had created in the previous term. Could you please clarify whether I need to create the se2001 directory again and write all the BPT code once more, or should i only do synchro eval.

image1643×532 39.9 KB

posts.name: Pammi Tiwari
posts.cooked: I had created it in the last term and completed all the BPTs. I assumed that doing the synchro evaluation this term would be sufficient.But my se2001 directory is deleted and i can’t able to synchro eval.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: You can re-create the directory and solve the assignments.
